legend: This is an interactive problem. In the interaction section below you will see the information about flushing the output.
In this problem, you will be playing a game with Hongcow. How lucky of you!
Hongcow has a hidden n by n matrix M. Let Mi, j denote the entry i-th row and j-th column of the matrix. The rows and columns are labeled from 1 to n.

The matrix entries are between 0 and 109. In addition, Mi, i = 0 for all valid i. Your task is to find the minimum value along each row, excluding diagonal elements. Formally, for each i, you must find ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/3943866668dac6c7c35903f90df68a3d53ff6de1.png).
To do this, you can ask Hongcow some questions.

A question consists of giving Hongcow a subset of distinct indices {w1, w2, ..., wk}, with 1 ≤ k ≤ n. Hongcow will respond with n integers. The i-th integer will contain the minimum value of min1 ≤ j ≤ kMi, wj.
You may only ask Hongcow at most 20 questions — he thinks you only need that many questions answered.

When you are ready to answer, print out a single integer  - 1 on its own line, then n integers on the next line. The i-th integer should be the minimum value in the i-th row of the matrix, excluding the i-th element. Do not forget to flush the final answer as well. Printing the answer does not count as asking a question.
You will get Wrong Answer verdict if
Your question or answers are not in the format described in this statement.
You ask strictly more than 20 questions.
The value of k in your question does not lie in the range from 1 to n, inclusive.
Your final answer is not correct.
input: The first line of input will contain a single integer n (2 ≤ n ≤ 1, 000).
output: To print the final answer, print out the string -1 on its own line. Then, the next line should contain n integers. The i-th integer should be the minimum value of the i-th row of the matrix, excluding elements on the diagonal. Do not forget to flush your answer!

To ask a question, print out a single integer k on its own line, denoting the size of your subset. Then, the next line should contain k integers w1, w2, ... wk. Note, you must flush your output to get a response.
Hongcow will respond by printing out a line with n integers. The i-th integer in this line represents the minimum value of Mi, wj where j is between 1 and k.
You may only ask a question at most 20 times, otherwise, you will get Wrong Answer.

legend.ai: 这是一道交互题。在下面的交互部分中，你将看到有关刷新输出的信息。
在这道题中，你将与 Hongcow 进行一场游戏。你真幸运！
Hongcow 有一个隐藏的 n×n 矩阵 M。令 Mi, j 表示矩阵第 i 行第 j 列的元素。行和列均从 1 标号到 n。
矩阵中的元素均在 0 到 109 之间。此外，对于所有合法的 i，都有 Mi, i = 0。你的任务是找出每一行中排除对角线元素后的最小值。形式化地，对于每个 i，你必须求出 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/3943866668dac6c7c35903f90df68a3d53ff6de1.png)。
为此，你可以向 Hongcow 提出一些问题。
一个问题由给出一个由互不相同的下标组成的子集 {w1, w2, ..., wk} 构成，其中 1 ≤ k ≤ n。Hongcow 将回复 n 个整数。第 i 个整数将包含 min1 ≤ j ≤ kMi, wj 的最小值。
你最多只能向 Hongcow 提出 20 个问题，因为他认为你只需要得到这么多问题的答案。
当你准备好回答时，请在单独一行输出整数 - 1，然后在下一行输出 n 个整数。第 i 个整数应为矩阵第 i 行中除第 i 个元素外的最小值。不要忘记刷新最终答案。输出答案不计入提问次数。
如果出现以下情况，你将得到错误答案（Wrong Answer）判定：
你的问题或答案不符合本题面所描述的格式。
你提出了严格多于 20 个问题。
你的问题中包含重复的下标。
问题中的 k 不在 1 到 n（包含 1 和 n）的范围内。

output.ai: 要输出最终答案，请单独输出一行字符串 -1。接下来一行应包含 n 个整数。第 i 个整数应为矩阵第 i 行中除对角线元素外的最小值。不要忘记刷新输出！
要提问，请单独输出一行整数 k，表示你的子集大小。接下来一行应包含 k 个整数 w1, w2, ... wk。注意，你必须刷新输出才能获得响应。
Hongcow 将输出一行，其中包含 n 个整数。这一行中的第 i 个整数表示 Mi, wj 的最小值，其中 j 介于 1 和 k 之间。
你最多只能提问 20 次，否则将得到错误答案。
